svg.text: SEQUENCED FAN-OUT, PREBID SERVER AS THE HOST
How the orchestrator sequences the containers when Prebid Server hosts ARTF
Prebid's ARTF hook calls the orchestrator once at processed-auction-request. Stages 1 to 3 run and are applied in order;
Prebid applies the returned list itself before its bidders see the request. Stage 4 does not run here: no bids exist yet.
PREBID SERVER (EKS) THE SELL-SIDE ARTF HOST
posts the request as an ARTF envelope,
applies the reply in list order
margins: stages 1 to 3, in that order
ORCHESTRATOR (EKS) ONE REQUEST, FOUR SEQUENTIAL STAGES
Containers within a stage run in parallel. Between stages the orchestrator applies the returned mutations to a working copy of the bid request,
so each stage reads what the stage before it wrote. Budget: each stage gets the time remaining under tmax, floored at 10 ms.
scores ONLY the deals now in
inert on this path: no seatbid
Four of the six containers call it: Deal Scorer (NCF), both Yield Optimizers (XGBoost via the FIL backend) and the Bid Pricer (DLRM). The enrichers in stage 1 are rule-based and do not.
Each stage receives the time left under tmax,
floored at 10 ms. A slow container is reported
timeout; the next stage still runs.

runs all stages. metadata.stages is null on pass 1.
